name: Alex
raw_text: I want to become an AI engineer in 6 months. I'm already comfortable with Python (80%) and web development (70%), and I know a bit of ML (20%).
notes: Demo persona #1 for the required demo video (Section 6). Stronger starting skills than Priya — should get a visibly more advanced/faster-paced roadmap.

name: Priya
raw_text: I want to become an AI engineer in 6 months. I only know about 20% Python, no web development experience, and maybe 5% ML.
notes: Demo persona #2. Same goal and timeline as Alex, near-zero starting skills — should get a visibly different, more foundational roadmap. The two roadmaps diverging is the core proof point for the demo script.

name: Edge case: vague goal
raw_text: I want to get better with data.
notes: Should trigger missing_fields + a follow_up_question, not a confident guess.

name: Edge case: changes goal after starting
raw_text: Actually I've changed my mind, I want to focus on web development instead of data science now.
notes: Run this as a second onboarding pass on an existing learner_id — tests that profile updates (PUT /api/profile/{id}) actually reshape the next roadmap generation.

name: Edge case: advanced learner, 1 month
raw_text: I'm an advanced data scientist, I just need to close gaps in deep learning and deployment before an interview in 4 weeks.
notes: Tests that beginner-level filler content doesn't leak into an advanced, time-constrained roadmap.

name: Edge case: forced empty candidate set
raw_text: I want to learn underwater basket weaving for a certification in 2 months.
notes: Outside all 3 in-scope domains — should trigger the 'No candidates found' empty state (Section 8), not a hallucinated roadmap.

name: Edge case: forced AI/API failure
raw_text: (use with GEMINI_API_KEY temporarily unset and no fallback keys configured)
notes: Confirms POST /api/roadmap/generate returns 422 roadmap_generation_failed and the frontend shows the retry state, not a raw stack trace.
